description:
One release as a listing shows it: everything but what it changed.

Kept apart from [`Release`] rather than being it with the entries left out,
because the two are read for different things. A listing answers which releases
there have been and which of them was taken back; only the one being read needs
to carry every line of what it changed.

delivers.description: What it set out to deliver.

patches.description: The version this one patched, where it is a patch.

released_on.description: The day it was published, where the record of it says.

user_facing.description: Whether anything in it is a change an operator would notice.

withdrawn.description: Why it was withdrawn, where it was.
